_meta.how: computed = getComputedStyle / a probe element resolving var() in the running Zen (Marionette chrome context); pixel = mean of a patch from a native-resolution (2x) region capture of an ACTIVE window over a bright striped backdrop (active) or with another app active (inactive = flat, no glass); source files: ~/work/koan/.cache/zen-ref/raw/colors-computed.json, colors-pixels.json, colors-sample-meta.json; screenshots: s/c-{dark,light}-{active,inactive,urlbar,appmenu,ctxmenu}.png (not committed, contain the test backdrop).
_meta.default_theme: No colours in the Space (opacity 0.5, texture 0). Scheme set through pref zen.view.window.scheme (0 dark, 1 light).
_meta.glass_note: On macOS the window is a native vibrancy view under a theme layer, so any colour marked "glass" depends on what is behind the window (and on window-material, default 1). The flat/opaque values are what you get when the window is inactive, or with zen.widget.macos.window-vibrancy=false; they are the safe base for an opaque implementation.
_meta.accent_note: The default primary colour is NOT the same in both schemes: dark rgb(2,41,84) (navy), light rgb(22,131,255) (macOS-like blue).

frame_sidebar_background.css: #zen-browser-background::after (theme layer) over NSVisualEffectView; opaque fallback = :-moz-window-inactive background (InactiveCaption)

dark.note: also --zen-main-browser-background = #1b1b1b used for the page-card default when no layer

frame_sidebar_background.includes: sidebar, the top row, and the 8 pt ring around the page card (same layer)

content_area_behind_page_card_(the_8pt_r.css: same #zen-browser-background layer; the card sits above it

page_card_blank_page_background.css: #tabbrowser-tabpanels browser[type=content] (a blank or new-tab document is transparent: the glass shows through)
page_card_blank_page_background.note: a real web page is opaque: its own background (e.g. example.com rendered dark/light by content-theme)

panel_app_menu.css: --arrowpanel-background (the panel material also gets native popover glass, so the on-screen colour varies)
panel_app_menu.note: appMenu-popup / arrowpanel elements have a transparent own background in the DOM; the frosted look is the native popover material. Pixel patches over the striped backdrop ranged widely (see colors-pixels.json) so use the variable, plus blur.

context_menu_native.css: native NSMenu (widget.macos.native-context-menus = true): colours come from macOS, not Zen CSS
context_menu_native.note: highlighted item is the macOS system accent (blue in this Mac), text SF 13 pt; the menu follows the SYSTEM appearance, not zen.view.window.scheme

dark.border: outline 0.5px solid rgb(75, 75, 75)  (#4b4b4b)  (a 1 px #4b4b4b row at the top edge in the capture)

light.border: outline 0.5px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)  (a #979797 row over the page in the capture)

floating_urlbar_card_Cmd+T.note: opaque by default (zen.theme.acrylic-urlbar=false); with acrylic: rgba(20,20,20,.92) dark / rgba(255,255,255,.93) light + blur(40px)

tab_title_text.note: the toolbox text colour is derived from the theme primary colour

accent.note: accent is clamped in oklch lightness 0.35-0.6 (backgrounds) / lifted for text on dark; selected options, welcome primary button, selected URL result use these

inactive_window_flat.css: #zen-main-app-wrapper:-moz-window-inactive { background: InactiveCaption } (zen.view.grey-out-inactive-windows = true), native vibrancy goes flat when the window is not active
inactive_window_flat.measured_with: window INACTIVE (another app active), zen.widget.macos.window-vibrancy = true (glass on), default theme

light.frame / sidebar / ring: #e5e5e5 = rgb(229, 229, 229) (spread 0; ring edges #e3e3e3 .. #dcdcdc near the window edge)

inactive_window_flat.note: These are the SYSTEM colours Gecko resolves for InactiveCaption in each appearance, not --zen-main-browser-background (#1b1b1b / #ebebeb); the theme colour layer is not visible while inactive (verified with the default theme only).

theme_panel_placement.anchor: #TabsToolbar (the sidebar tab area: x 6 .. sidebarWidth-6, y 81 .. windowHeight-6), NOT the toolbox or the URL bar
theme_panel_placement.position: topright topleft, x -10, y 0 (y -160 only when opened from the Create-Space form Edit Theme button)
theme_panel_placement.measured_window_coords: left edge x = sidebarWidth + 7 (262 -> 269, 230 -> 237); vertical centre = centre of #TabsToolbar, i.e. top y = 81 + (TabsToolbarHeight - 514)/2 (720 high window -> 141, 923 high -> 242); no popover tail (hidepopovertail=true)
theme_panel_placement.entry_points_all_same_command: cmd_zenOpenZenThemePicker: Space "more actions" > Theme... (context_zenChangeWorkspaceTheme), sidebar context menu > Theme picker (zenToolbarThemePicker), Spaces menu > Theme...
